artifacts/elmtree_index.db.description: Search index (SQLite): every composition's ElMD vector plus the database records it appears in. Made by convert-index from the original web search's lookup tables, or by build-index from a CSV

instance.description: Find the k compositions in the indexed databases most similar to a query composition, by Element Movers Distance (ElMD).

k.description: Number of nearest neighbours to return (1-1000)

must_contain.description: Only return compositions containing all of these elements, e.g. ["Li", "O"]

must_exclude.description: Only return compositions containing none of these elements

experimental_only.description: Only return compositions found in at least one experimental database

structures_only.description: Only return compositions found in at least one database with crystal structures

normalised_query.description: The query as a normalised ElMD formula (fractional amounts)

nearest_match.description: The most similar composition in the indexed databases

nearest_distance.description: Element Movers Distance from the query to the nearest match (0 = identical)

elmtree_results.html.description: Results page laid out like the original ElMTree search: each neighbour's composition, the kinds of database it is reported in, its IDs in each database and its distance

neighbours.csv.description: All neighbours, closest first: rank, formula, normalised_formula, distance, databases (the records in each database, as database: ids)

dataset.description: Search for the nearest neighbours of many compositions from a CSV with a 'composition' column. Produces a CSV with one row per query and neighbour.

file.description: CSV file with a 'composition' column of chemical formulas

k.description: Number of nearest neighbours per query (1-1000)

must_contain.description: Only return compositions containing all of these elements

must_exclude.description: Only return compositions containing none of these elements

experimental_only.description: Only return compositions found in at least one experimental database

structures_only.description: Only return compositions found in at least one database with crystal structures

elmtree_results.html.description: Results page with each query's neighbours laid out like the original ElMTree search (the first 500 queries)

neighbours.csv.description: One row per query and neighbour: query_row, query, rank, formula, normalised_formula, distance, databases, error
